stories.headline: Dell lifts outlook on surging AI server demand
stories.summary: Dell raised its annual revenue forecast to $192 billion from $167 billion after quarterly revenue jumped 58%. It reported $60 billion in AI-server orders and a $95 billion backlog.

stories.headline: US debt passes $40 trillion
stories.summary: U.S. debt exceeded $40 trillion during Trump's second term. Reuters attributes the rise to current policy and longer-running bipartisan fiscal pressures; future tax increases or benefit cuts may be difficult to avoid.

stories.headline: US and Iran resume major exchange of strikes
stories.summary: The U.S. struck Iranian military targets near the Strait of Hormuz; Iran retaliated against U.S. sites across the region. Iran reported civilian deaths at a wedding, which Reuters could not independently verify.

stories.headline: Russian strikes cut power across Odesa
stories.summary: A large Russian missile-and-drone attack damaged Odesa energy infrastructure and cut power, while attacks on Kyiv continued for a seventh day. Ukrainian officials reported injuries and residential damage.

stories.headline: Rescuers see hope for workers trapped in Nepal
stories.summary: An electricity official said 46 workers may be alive in a room-like space inside a hydropower tunnel with food and water. At least 639 people remain missing from flooded power sites; the assessment is not yet confirmed.
